words.definition_en: So slight or delicate as to be difficult to detect.
words.example_from_video: Every night, the brain performs a subtle yet profound transformation.
words.example_extra: There is a subtle difference between the two translations.
words.example_zh: 这两个译本之间有一处细微的差别。
words.why_hard: 一词多义：既可指「细微」也可指「精妙」；b 不发音，听力易漏辨

words.definition_en: Very great or intense, especially in effect or insight.
words.example_from_video: Every night, the brain performs a subtle yet profound transformation.
words.example_extra: The discovery had a profound impact on modern medicine.
words.example_zh: 这项发现对现代医学产生了深远影响。
words.why_hard: 低频学术词，常与 impact / effect / change 构成固定搭配

words.definition_en: To make a memory, skill or position stable and durable.
words.example_from_video: It consolidates fragile memory traces into durable neural circuits.
words.example_extra: The course consolidates everything we covered last term.
words.example_zh: 这门课把上学期学过的内容都巩固了一遍。
words.why_hard: 学科术语：记忆巩固为心理学专用义；与 solid 同源易误判为「变硬」

words.definition_en: To become progressively worse in quality or condition.
words.example_from_video: Without sufficient sleep, this process deteriorates rapidly.
words.example_extra: Her eyesight deteriorated sharply over the winter.
words.example_zh: 整个冬天她的视力急剧下降。
words.why_hard: 低频书面动词，拼写长；不及物用法居多，易误加宾语

words.definition_en: Lasting only for a short time; impermanent.
words.example_from_video: The hippocampus holds new information only transiently.
words.example_extra: The drug causes a transient drop in blood pressure.
words.example_zh: 这种药会引起血压短暂下降。
words.why_hard: 词形生僻：字幕用的是副词 transiently，需归并；易与 transitory 混淆

words.definition_en: Based on observation or experiment rather than theory.
words.example_from_video: Later experiments provided empirical proof of the mechanism.
words.example_extra: The claim still lacks empirical support.
words.example_zh: 这一说法仍缺乏实证支持。
words.why_hard: 学术术语，与 evidence / data / study 高频搭配；易与 imperial 拼混

words.definition_en: Relating to mental processes such as thinking and remembering.
words.example_from_video: Those deprived of REM showed a measurable cognitive deficit.
words.example_extra: Sleep loss impairs cognitive performance the next morning.
words.example_zh: 睡眠不足会损害次日早晨的认知表现。
words.why_hard: 学科术语，几乎只修饰 ability / performance / bias 等抽象名词

words.definition_en: A shortage or lack of something required.
words.example_from_video: Those deprived of REM showed a measurable cognitive deficit.
words.example_extra: The company reported a budget deficit of two million.
words.example_zh: 公司报告了两百万的预算赤字。
words.why_hard: 一词多义：医学指功能缺陷、经济指赤字；搭配 attention / cognitive deficit

words.definition_en: Causing harm or damage.
words.example_from_video: Chronic restriction is particularly detrimental to attention.
words.example_extra: Excessive screen time can be detrimental to sleep quality.
words.example_zh: 屏幕时间过长可能不利于睡眠质量。
words.why_hard: 固定搭配 detrimental to + 名词，介词 to 不可换为 for

words.definition_en: To weaken or damage a function or ability.
words.example_from_video: Even a single short night can impair judgment the following day.
words.example_extra: Alcohol impairs the ability to react quickly.
words.example_zh: 酒精会削弱快速反应的能力。
words.why_hard: 及物动词，宾语多为抽象能力名词；名词形式 impairment 常一起考

words.definition_en: Relating to the roughly 24-hour biological cycle.
words.example_from_video: Circadian rhythms modulate when consolidation is most efficient.
words.example_extra: Jet lag disrupts the body's circadian rhythm.
words.example_zh: 时差会打乱人体的昼夜节律。
words.why_hard: 学科术语，几乎只与 rhythm / clock 搭配；发音与拼写不匹配

words.definition_en: To adjust or regulate the strength or pattern of something.
words.example_from_video: Circadian rhythms modulate when consolidation is most efficient.
words.example_extra: The device modulates the signal to reduce noise.
words.example_zh: 该设备通过调制信号来降低噪声。
words.why_hard: 低频学术动词；生理语境义为「调节」，通信语境义为「调制」

words.definition_en: Seeming reasonable or probable, though not proven.
words.example_from_video: A plausible hypothesis links poor clearance to neurodegeneration.
words.example_extra: That sounds plausible, but we need more data.
words.example_zh: 这听起来有道理，但我们还需要更多数据。
words.why_hard: 易混词：plausible 指「看似合理」，possible 仅指「可能」；隐含未证实

words.definition_en: Likely to be affected or harmed by something.
words.example_from_video: Older adults appear especially susceptible to such disruption.
words.example_extra: Children are more susceptible to respiratory infections.
words.example_zh: 儿童更容易感染呼吸道疾病。
words.why_hard: 固定搭配 susceptible to + 名词；拼写含 -pt-，易误写为 succeptible

words.definition_en: Increasing in effect or amount by successive additions.
words.example_from_video: The cumulative effect across decades can be substantial.
words.example_extra: The cumulative damage becomes visible only after years.
words.example_zh: 累积的损伤往往多年后才显现。
words.why_hard: 低频学术形容词，常修饰 effect / impact / exposure

words.definition_en: Having many complex, finely interlinked parts.
words.example_from_video: This intricate pruning preserves what matters and discards noise.
words.example_extra: The watch contains an intricate network of tiny gears.
words.example_zh: 这块表里有一套精密复杂的微型齿轮组。
words.why_hard: 易混词：intricate 强调结构精细，complex 只指复杂；常与 network / pattern 搭配

words.definition_en: Without intention; accidentally.
words.example_from_video: Caffeine can inadvertently delay the onset of slow-wave sleep.
words.example_extra: I inadvertently deleted the wrong file.
words.example_zh: 我不小心删错了文件。
words.why_hard: 长副词，拼写易错；语域偏书面，口语可用 by accident 替换

words.meaning_zh: 无处不在的；普遍存在的
words.definition_en: Present or found everywhere.
words.example_from_video: A ubiquitous stimulant, it masks the body's sleep pressure.
words.example_extra: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in daily life.
words.example_zh: 智能手机在日常生活中已无处不在。
words.why_hard: 高阶低频词，发音重音在第二音节；常作前置定语或表语

words.definition_en: To make something harmful or unpleasant less severe.
words.example_from_video: To mitigate the damage, keep a consistent schedule.
words.example_extra: Planting trees helps mitigate the urban heat island effect.
words.example_zh: 植树有助于缓解城市热岛效应。
words.why_hard: 易混词：mitigate 是「减轻」，militate against 是「妨碍」；写作高频搭配 risk / damage

words.definition_en: Never having happened or existed before.
words.example_from_video: An unprecedented mismatch between biology and environment.
words.example_extra: The city faced an unprecedented heatwave last summer.
words.example_zh: 去年夏天这座城市遭遇了前所未有的热浪。
words.why_hard: 否定前缀 + 长词根；常修饰 scale / level / growth，新闻语域高频
